# v25.1.0 (CIRISPersist#577 follow-up) — adopted from CIRISVerify's registry
# (CIRISVerify#233), which shipped this section first and was right to.
# Shipped, tested persist surface with NO CC identifier yet. Listed here so the
# Constitution can issue decimals against real implementations rather than
# against a proposal — the direction that matches how every one of these was
# actually built (persist implements, CC ratifies, and the RC3 batch #46/#47/
# #48/#49/#67 is that loop running).
# The decimal column carries `—`, which is CC check_claims.py's documented skip
# sentinel (`if not dec or dec == "—": continue`). The literal string
# "UNASSIGNED" there would be neither empty nor `—`, so the checker would add
# it to the backed-DECIMAL set — registering a fake identifier. The
# awaiting-assignment marker therefore rides the CLM name instead, where it
# cannot be mistaken for a CC decimal.
# These cannot rot while they wait: persist's OWN resolver
# (`evidence_cc_impl_pointers_resolve`) requires a definition for every src/
# row regardless of decimal, so a rename fails our build even before CC sees
# it. Proposed CLM names are suggestions, not claims.
